comment: Copy this file to project.json and customize for your OpenStack project
comment2: This file configures which project the agents monitor (octavia, neutron, nova, etc.)
comment3: All agents will adapt automatically: CLI commands, output paths, repos, etc.

project.name: octavia
project.comment_slug: Filesystem-safe identifier used in paths, CLI commands, systemd units. If omitted, defaults to lowercased name with slashes replaced by dashes.
project.comment_launchpad_tags: Optional list of tags to filter bugs (e.g., ['ovn-octavia-provider'] to only get bugs tagged with that). Leave empty for no tag filtering.
project.comment_repos: Git repositories to monitor for code reviews, CI failures, etc. Format: 'org/repo'
project.comment_devstack: systemd service names for health checks. Leave empty if project has no DevStack services.
project.comment_dirs: Output directories. Defaults: ~/{slug}_bug_triages, ~/{slug}_reviews, etc. Can override here.
project.comment_tracking: Tracking files. Defaults: ~/.{slug}_bug_triages.json, etc. Can override here.
